topic: The movie that accidentally predicted a major world event with perfect accuracy
hook: This film accidentally predicted a major world event exactly.
script: This film accidentally predicted a major world event exactly. The 1993 film Demolition Man predicted a Schwarzenegger presidency — called impossible at the time. He became governor of California in 2003. Super Mario Bros predicted a real-world fungal pandemic threatening humanity. Contagion from 2011 modelled a coronavirus outbreak spreading from a wet market in Asia with 99% accuracy. Follow for films that didn't know they were documentaries.
